_doc: The spine: what stays the SAME in every video so a channel feels like one studio. Everything else (the world) changes every time.

presenter.zone: bottom third of the frame when visible, waist-up, never covered by graphics on the face
presenter.visibility: present for the hook and for the personal moments, absent for stretches where the world carries the beat; always back for the close

realism: Every plate reads as photographed or physically-lit 3D: real materials, real light, shallow depth of field, tactile detail. One consistent world per video.
type: Big Hebrew kinetic type, one idea per screen, set INSIDE the world whenever possible (on a sign, a stamp, a chart, a label) and as a clean overlay when not. Max 4 words per headline. Accent colour on the one word that matters.
captions: Small, always readable, max 3 words at a time, word timing from the real voice. Sit above the presenter or at the lower third, never over the face.
cover: Every video ships with covers. The first frame of the video is already the cover: the hook is on screen at t=0.
